Dear Alan,

Welcome to Tax Advocate Group, and thank you for choosing us to represent you in your tax resolution journey. We’re honored by your trust and fully committed to helping you navigate this process with clarity, confidence, and the best possible outcome before the IRS and/or state taxing authorities.

We’re pleased to confirm that your Power of Attorney (Form 2848) has been successfully filed. This authorization allows our team to communicate directly with the IRS on your behalf, access the necessary records, and begin the process of resolving your tax matters efficiently and effectively.

What Happens Next

• Transcript Review: We will retrieve and analyze your IRS transcripts and tax history.

• Case Evaluation: Our specialists will assess your financial situation and determine the most effective resolution options available.

• Next Steps & Updates: You will receive regular updates as we progress through the investigation and resolution phases of your case.

 

Please notify us immediately if you receive any letters or notices from the IRS or state agencies so we can respond on your behalf. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to us at:

Contact Information

General Questions: 800-517-1807

Documents & IRS Correspondence: Processing@TaxAdvocateGroup.com

We’re excited to have you on board and look forward to helping you achieve a successful resolution. Thank you again for placing your trust in Tax Advocate Group.

Warm regards,

Tax Advocate Group

activitiesPreview.comment:
Subject: TAX ORGINAZER
Message:

CASE ID: 330049 - TAX ORGANIZER | ACTION REQUIRED!

Dear BIANCA,

In order to optimize the preparation of your tax returns, it is imperative that we gather accurate income and expense data directly from you. It's important to note that we are unable to generate this information on your behalf.

To facilitate the accurate preparation of your tax returns, we kindly request that you provide us with the following documents for each applicable year:

  • All W-2 forms
  • 1099 forms
  • Copy of prior year return (if not prepared by our company)
  • Any other pertinent income tax documents

To streamline this process and assist you in organizing the necessary information, we have attached client tax organizers for your convenience. Please take the time to complete a tax organizer for each year of tax preparation within the specified range (2018-2025).

We emphasize that the responsibility of providing complete and accurate information lies with you, as this is crucial for the preparation of meticulous returns.

You may forward the required information via either of the following methods:

Fax: (442)333-1097 Email: processing@taxadvocategroup.com

To ensure the timely completion of your tax returns and avoid any potential penalties, kindly return the completed documents no later than thirty (30) business days ahead of the tax deadline (April 15th). If the need for an extension to file arises, we ask that you promptly inform us within thirty (30) days of receiving this email.

Should you have any questions or concerns, please be assured that our team is readily available to address them. Your prompt attention to this matter is greatly appreciated.

Thank you for entrusting us with your tax-related needs.

Best regards, 
Tax Advocate Group | Tax Prep Department
Phone: (800) 517-1807
